raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions ignores the currency column, so 80 EUR rows are summed as if they were USD. raw_fx_rates has a single unambiguous EUR rate (1.25 to USD), so I convert amounts to USD in silver and the gold tables follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(CAST(r.amount AS DOUBLE) * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = r.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
